items.title: fix: preserve trajectory events in shared session stores (#138240)
items.summary: fix: preserve trajectory events in shared session stores (#138240) * fix(trajectory): reuse canonical shared-store ownership Route trajectory writes and reads through canonical SQLite scope resolution so logical agents can record, tail, and export events in a shared store without changing its physical owner. Remove the duplicate adapter while retaining non-shared owner rejection and existing retention behavior. Verified failing-before shared recorder/export regressions, 116 focused tests, and actual runtime recording plus CLI tail/export through an isolated admitted worker WebSocket flow with synthetic provider inference. * docs: correct task and trajectory database locations

items.title: fix(testbox): preserve complete source snapshots (#138404)
items.summary: fix(testbox): preserve complete source snapshots (#138404) Freeze policy-selected raw source into the existing Git-bundle path and verify filesystem bytes, symlink targets, executable flags, and producer-owned deletions before executing Testbox proof. Remove the unverified remote auto-commit and fingerprint the actual source-owner modules. Closes #138153. Verified native checksum-full recovery against the complete source hash; 284/284 Linux owner tests passed with an unchanged candidate manifest. Native openrsync deletion of ignored runtime directories remains a separate limitation.

items.title: 思科發布9月IOS XR安全強化更新，修補7個資安漏洞
items.summary: 9月2日思科針對網路設備平臺IOS XR發布9月份安全強化更新，總共修補7個漏洞，2個為重大等級，其餘為高風險等級，該公司強調，這些弱點影響所有版本的IOS XR，其中包含了IOS XR7（LNT），由於沒有替代緩解措施，呼籲用戶應套用軟體更新因應。
